title: Seat Participation
description: A seat's participation in a specific LHB event (buy or sell side).

event_id.description: Identifier of the LHB event this participation belongs to.

rank.description: Rank of the seat within the side's leaderboard.

buy_amount.description: Buy amount attributed to this seat for this event.

sell_amount.description: Sell amount attributed to this seat for this event.

amount_share.description: Share of the total amount attributable to this seat, between 0 and 1.

available_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this participation record became available (business time).

identity_confidence.description: Confidence score for the seat identity in this participation, between 0 and 1.
